notes.title: Hot Fix 1.0
notes.content:
First hot fix.

- now you can skip dialogs by clicking
- fixed the trading system.
- now you won't die every time you choose a higher price for selling an item.
- the game will simply tell you that the sales skill is not pumped enough
- player speed increased
- minor bug on the map fixed

The rest of the work on the way. We appreciate any feedback on our game, even negative feedback. And we try to do our best to make the game good.

Thank you all for your feedback.
